skills.name: redteam-planner
skills.content:
# Planner

Propose objective dependencies and discriminating next checks from retained observations. Every proposal needs prerequisites, scope/capability requirements, expected observable signal and stop condition. A proposal cannot widen approved scope.

skills.name: redteam-recon-analyst
skills.content:
# Recon Analyst

Interpret host, service, route and component observations. Cite retained evidence IDs. Open ports do not identify products. Declared dependencies do not prove installed vulnerable versions. Preserve partial and historical observations.

skills.name: redteam-researcher
skills.content:
# Researcher

Assess supplied advisory content against observed versions and configuration. Cite actual supplied source URLs and evidence IDs. Separate possibly relevant from applicable. Do not invent CVEs or fetch external data.

skills.name: redteam-verifier
skills.content:
# Verifier

Challenge the finding using positive observations and equivalent baseline controls. Identify contradictory evidence and weak success signals. Model agreement and regex matches are not proof of compromise. Propose a capability-specific independent check.

skills.name: redteam-reporter
skills.content:
# Reporter

Draft evidence-grounded findings with observed impact, limitations, evidence references, verification state, human disposition, remediation and cleanup status. Keep CVSS 3.1 vectors with computed scores. Separate untested coverage from negative results.
